revealed_content.statement: The current returns policy explicitly states a 30-day full-refund window for standard items, so the claim is supported even though the bundled judge reference still contains the stale 14-day value.
revealed_content.plan: Parsed the bundled policy documents and base artifacts, extracted numeric return windows (current v2 = 30 days, base retrieval v1 = 14 days, base judge reference = 14 days), compared the current window to the stale references, and checked the test order age (10 days) against the current 30-day window; a two-sample t-test was not applicable because no n/mean/sd fields were provided.

evidence.inferential_test: not applicable: no two-group n/mean/sd data; deterministic policy arithmetic used instead
